summary: Split gpt-copy-v7 into foundation, backend persistence/provider/API, frontend client/UI/streaming, documentation, and final QA waves. The graph keeps OpenRouter server-side, requires mocked provider tests, preserves SQLite/sqlx persistence, and sequences streaming and Playwright work after stable backend/frontend contracts.

proposals.title: Root hygiene and documented local workflow
proposals.summary: Prepare repository-level ignore rules, placeholder-only environment examples, and README command guidance without secrets or generated artifacts.

proposals.title: Backend Axum SQLite OpenRouter service
proposals.summary: Build a Rust 2024 Axum backend with sqlx SQLite migrations, structured validation/errors, CORS/tracing, OpenRouter provider abstraction, JSON chat endpoints, SSE streaming, and mocked tests.

proposals.title: Frontend ChatGPT-style Next.js client
proposals.summary: Build a Next.js App Router TypeScript Tailwind frontend with zod-validated API client, TanStack Query state, markdown transcript UI, native streaming fetch, component tests, and mocked Playwright smoke coverage.

proposals.title: Final verification and artifact hygiene
proposals.summary: Run backend/frontend verification commands, Playwright smoke, secret scans, and generated-artifact checks before final CodeDungeon reporting.

risks.title: OpenRouter leakage into browser or tracked files
risks.impact: Exposes provider credentials or violates the server-side proxy boundary.
risks.mitigation: Keep OPENROUTER_API_KEY only in backend runtime config, expose only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to the frontend, keep .env ignored, and run a tracked-file secret scan before completion.

risks.title: Streaming persistence can save partial assistant output
risks.impact: Interrupted or malformed provider streams could corrupt conversation history.
risks.mitigation: Persist the user message before provider streaming, accumulate assistant deltas in memory, persist the assistant message only after stream completion, and test interrupted stream behavior with mocks.

risks.title: Backend and frontend response schemas drift
risks.impact: The UI may pass tests against stale mocks while failing against the Axum API.
risks.mitigation: Stabilize backend DTOs before frontend integration, mirror them in zod schemas, and include malformed-response tests.

risks.title: Automated tests accidentally call external OpenRouter
risks.impact: Tests become flaky, consume quota, or require local secrets.
risks.mitigation: Inject ChatProvider mocks in backend tests and mock all browser network calls in component and Playwright tests.

claims.title: Use parallel foundation tracks
claims.summary: Root docs, backend scaffold, and frontend scaffold can start independently because they own separate paths and establish contracts for later waves.

claims.title: Separate backend streaming from JSON chat
claims.summary: The JSON send endpoint should land before SSE so persistence, provider mapping, and test fixtures are stable for the more failure-prone streaming path.

claims.title: Provider access is server-only
claims.summary: All OpenRouter configuration and HTTP calls stay under backend/, and frontend tests must assert no browser request targets OpenRouter.

claims.title: Final completion depends on verification evidence
claims.summary: Completion should not be reported until backend commands, frontend commands, Playwright smoke, secret scan, and generated-artifact checks have passing evidence.
